annotations.text:
Rebuilt as true vector — the original was a raster with soft AI-render edges, so it could not scale.

Same palette: #1A1E23 ground, #2E7D4F green, white numerals. Same monoline language, same rounded-square container.

The 420-friendly move: a monoline cannabis leaf living inside the counter of the 0, drawn at the same stroke weight as everything else. One move, not five.

Primary lockup = social, 1:1.
Icon only = avatar, favicon, stamp.
On light = print, invoices, contracts.
Horizontal = web header, email signature.

Green is a tweak chip above each artboard if you want to test a warmer or deeper green across all four.
